# [Implementation] - Quality Gate Evidence Contract (Plan-Aware Commands, Test-Run Cwd, Artifact Integrity)

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #298 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

## 6. Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Run from the worktree root, after the gate commands pass. Each fenced block is one check; the
harness executes them in order and fails the gate on the first non-zero exit, naming the check
and plan line.

#### Check 1 — This plan's Quality Gate Targets parse

```bash
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const { parseQualityGateTargets } = require("./dist/domain");
const text = fs.readFileSync("artifacts/plans/298-task-plan/implementation_plan.md", "utf8");
const result = parseQualityGateTargets(text);
if (!result.found) { console.error("S1 FAIL: Quality Gate Targets section not found"); process.exit(1); }
for (const command of ["npm run build", "npm run typecheck", "npm run lint", "npm test"]) {
  if (!result.commands.includes(command)) {
    console.error("S1 FAIL: missing target: " + command);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}
console.log("S1 PASS: " + result.commands.length + " plan targets parsed in order");
'
```

#### Check 2 — The Node detector emits lint

```bash
node -e '
const { FileBuildDetector } = require("./dist/infrastructure");
(async () => {
  const detected = await new FileBuildDetector().detect(process.cwd());
  const lint = detected.commands.find((c) => c.id === "lint");
  if (!lint) { console.error("S2 FAIL: detector emitted no lint command"); process.exit(1); }
  console.log("S2 PASS: " + lint.command);
})().catch((err) => { console.error("S2 FAIL: " + err.message); process.exit(1); });
'
```

#### Check 3 — The explicit test-run bypass accepts a mismatched issue

```bash
SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-298"
rm -rf "$SANDBOX"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
AGYLOOP_ALLOW_WORKTREE_ISSUE_MISMATCH=1 SANDBOX="$SANDBOX" node -e '
const path = require("node:path");
const { FileStateRepository } = require("./dist/infrastructure");
const now = new Date().toISOString();
const repo = new FileStateRepository({ stateFilePath: path.join(process.env.SANDBOX, "state.json") });
repo.save({ version: "1.0.0", currentStage: "QUALITY_GATE", mode: "standard", issue: 241, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, history: [] });
console.log("S3 PASS: mismatched issue save accepted under the explicit test flag");
'
rm -rf "$SANDBOX"
```

#### Check 4 — Plan source, lint enforcement and smoke extraction end to end

```bash
node -e '
const path = require("node:path");
const { resolveGateVerification } = require("./dist/application");
const { FileBuildDetector, FilePlanGenerator } = require("./dist/infrastructure");
(async () => {
  const result = await resolveGateVerification({
    projectRoot: process.cwd(),
    workspaceDir: process.cwd(),
    config: { options: {} },
    issue: 298,
    planPath: path.join(process.cwd(), "artifacts/plans/298-task-plan/implementation_plan.md"),
    planGenerator: new FilePlanGenerator(),
    buildDetector: new FileBuildDetector()
  });
  if (result.commandPlan.source !== "plan") {
    console.error("S4 FAIL: command source is " + result.commandPlan.source);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (!result.commandPlan.commands.some((c) => c.command === "npm run lint")) {
    console.error("S4 FAIL: lint command missing from the plan-sourced payload");
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (result.smoke.findings.length > 0) {
    console.error("S4 FAIL: smoke protocol has " + result.smoke.findings.length + " static findings");
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (result.smoke.checks.length !== 4) {
    console.error("S4 FAIL: expected 4 smoke checks, found " + result.smoke.checks.length);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log("S4 PASS: plan-sourced commands, lint enforced, smoke protocol executable");
})().catch((err) => { console.error("S4 FAIL: " + err.message); process.exit(1); });
'
```
